title: Magic direct patch report
findings: Uploaded PC and decrypted PS4 saves contain a high-confidence learned-magic list inside Player ChangeForm 400014 for normal spells and powers.
The learned-magic list layout is a little-endian u32 entry count followed by compact 3-byte RefIDs.
Shouts are not represented by that learned-spell list in the tested saves.
Shouts are represented by individual Word-of-Power ChangeForms whose RefID is the shout word ID.
Observed shout word ChangeForm payloads use the 6-byte pattern 49 00 XX 00 00 00, where XX=00 is locked and XX=01 is unlocked.
Direct Apply now routes spell/power changes through the learned-magic list patcher and shout changes through the Word-of-Power patcher.
Magic Favorites / hotkey data remains read-only.
safety_notes: Direct learned-list patching is refused if the detector cannot locate a medium/high-confidence list.
FE/light-plugin FormIDs are skipped until compact light-plugin RefIDs are mapped.
Checking a missing shout word inserts a new Word-of-Power ChangeForm and updates the changeform count and downstream table offset; keep backups until the save is verified in-game.
The generated teachword/unlockword console script remains available as a fallback.
